title: First two days of advance voting show fairly good turnout in Latvia
summary_full: During the first two days, around 38,600 people took the opportunity to cast their vote in advance of the 15th Saeima elections, whilst nearly 5,000 more citizens have applied to vote by post, which the Central Election Commission also counts as voter turnout, bringing the total to 2.79 per cent, according to the CVK's information on September 29.
